Background Image
?
How to get a direct image URL:
  1. Go to imgur.com (no account needed)
  2. Click "New post" and upload your image
  3. Right-click the uploaded image and select "Copy image address"
  4. Paste the URL here — it should end in .png or .jpg

Note: Google Drive and Dropbox links won't work — they block direct image loading. Use a proper image host like Imgur, Postimages, or any URL that links directly to the image file.
